# Third-Party Asset Credits

All third-party art and audio in Math Runner comes from **Kenney** ([www.kenney.nl](https://www.kenney.nl)).
Each pack is released under **Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)**
(<http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>): free for personal, educational and
commercial use. Credit isn't required; we give it anyway. Thank you, Kenney!

| Pack | Version | Folder | Used for |
|------|---------|--------|----------|
| New Platformer Pack | 1.1 | `Kenney/NewPlatformerPack/` | Player character, ground and platform tiles, spikes, finish flag |
| UI Pack | 2.0 | `Kenney/UIPack/` | Menu and HUD graphics (Stage B) |
| Interface Sounds | 1.0 | `Kenney/InterfaceSounds/` | UI and feedback sounds (Stage B4) |
| Background Elements Remastered | 2019 | `Kenney/Background/` | Meadow background painting and scenery props |
| Emotes (vector, Style 1) | — | `Kenney/EmotesUsed/` | Emote bubbles over critters (4 sprites copied from the Emotes pack) |

Each pack's original `License.txt` is kept in its folder. The packs' SVG `Vector` folders were
removed on purpose; only the PNG sprites and OGG sounds are used.

## Music

Both tracks are CC0 (public domain) from OpenGameArt.org; they live in `Assets/_Project/Audio/Music/`.

| Track | Author | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Happy Clappy Loop | OwlishMedia | <https://opengameart.org/content/happy-clappy-loop> | Menus and Meadow levels |
| Desert Loop | iamoneabe | <https://opengameart.org/content/desert-loop> | Desert levels |
